response.sql: WITH oc AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM "order" GROUP BY account_id), avg_all AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS a FROM oc), above AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count FROM oc, avg_all WHERE oc.order_count > avg_all.a), avg_above AS (SELECT AVG(order_count * 1.0) AS b FROM above) SELECT above.account_id, above.order_count, above.order_count - avg_all.a AS diff_from_avg, above.order_count - avg_above.b AS diff_from_above_avg FROM above, avg_all, avg_above ORDER BY diff_from_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
